name: __meta__
notes: Canonical cross-repo conformance fixture for the conflict-table severity + recommended-action formula (issue #1081, epic #1074).
Every conforming implementation (rp1-home Python, hapimatic-private #1970/#1971 TS) must reproduce each vector's expected.severity and expected.recommended_action.
Cross-repo consumers VENDOR this file with a provenance comment recording the source path + commit sha (native cross-repo sharing is epic #1083).
Thresholds/weights are PROVISIONAL and tunable from observe-phase data (#1079); on any change, bump spec_version and update these vectors in lockstep.
Change-kind vocabulary is {edit, rename, move, delete}. #1077's planned 'create' kind is OUT of vocabulary here — resolve at #1077 augment time (add 'create' or map to an existing kind).
Elements without an 'inputs' key (i.e. this __meta__ entry) are not conformance vectors and are skipped by the test.
